tvShow.name: Murder in a Small Town
tvShow.overview: Karl Alberg moves to a quiet coastal town to soothe a psyche that has been battered by big-city police work but finds himself needing to call upon all his skills to solve the murders that continue to wash up on his shore.

episodes.name: The Suspect
episodes.overview: When a longtime resident of the town ends up bludgeoned to death in his own home, Albert must determine if another longtime resident is to blame; Albert meets local librarian, Casandra Lee, for a first date.

episodes.name: Fall from Grace
episodes.overview: Former classmates of Cassandra's discover a dead body at the marina.

episodes.name: A Chill Rain
episodes.overview: When a dead body is discovered, Alberg begins the search for the killer.

episodes.name: Prized Possessions
episodes.overview: Cassandra reunites with a childhood friend who later discovers that her husband has gone missing.

episodes.name: A Touch of Panic
episodes.overview: Cassandra is placed in a life-threatening situation; police work to find the culprit responsible.

episodes.name: The Madness Method
episodes.overview: A murderer is on the loose and is headed towards Gibsons. In a race for time, the suspect's psychiatrist notifies Alberg of the potential threat after receiving a haunting text message. Alberg launches an investigation that takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.name: Family Concerns
episodes.overview: Detective Alberg examines the mysterious deaths of two women, each found in the forest with their bodies arranged in eerily similar poses.

episodes.name: Sleep While I Sing
episodes.overview: The investigation to find a possible serial killer in Gibsons continues. Alberg and his team piece together clues and discover an unusual pattern that relates back to familiar works of art. The unsettlement amongst the detectives prompts an urgent search to identify the killer.

episodes.name: Acts of Murder
episodes.overview: During a heated argument between a husband and wife, things get out of control. Meanwhile, Cassandra wins the final council seat in Gibsons, but Mayor Holman makes Karl Alberg an offer that would interfere with Cassandra’s plans.

episodes.name: Blood Wedding
episodes.overview: When a body is found at a local wedding between members of two feuding families, Alberg and team are called to the scene to investigate; Cassandra participates in a town hall debate and is confronted by Mayor Holman.

episodes.name: Mother Love
episodes.overview: A protective father becomes a lead suspect in a murder investigation when his ex-wife is killed just after returning to town. Cassandra assists a local unhoused man who is being tormented by local kids.

episodes.name: One Last Song
episodes.overview: A famous singer and her team go on a coastal trip to write music but things take a fatal turn. When conflicts arise among the housemates, a stalker, and ex-music partner, Karl and the unit must identify the real killer from a slew of suspects before they can escape by ferry.

episodes.name: Strangers Among Us
episodes.overview: A troubled high schooler discovers a wounded body in the woods, leading investigators to look for the attempted murderer. Cassandra dives deeper into her own investigation related to the mysterious deaths around Gibsons.

episodes.name: Trust, But Verify
episodes.overview: Karl and the team investigate a reported bear attack, leading to questions about foul play due to inconsistent stories.  Holly works on solving her own case.

episodes.name: This, That, and the Other Thing
episodes.overview: A dual kidnapping sends the Gibsons’ police force in a race against the clock. Work begins to seep into personal lives when Cassandra must make a tough call regarding budget issues with the city council.

episodes.name: Masterpiece
episodes.overview: Karl is called up to Seattle. Back in Gibsons, Cassandra deals with council conflicts and an unexpected visit from her mother while the police squad struggles when one of their own is missing.

episodes.name: The Fall of Holman
episodes.overview: Political deception is uncovered, and everyone becomes a suspect when Mayor Holman is attacked after hosting a fundraiser at her home.  Meanwhile, Cassandra gets a frightening visit from someone from her past.

episodes.name: Nightshade
episodes.overview: The police force investigates the murder of a man found dead at the bottom of his staircase. The team discovers an item at the scene of the crime that may be linked to other murders and could tie Cassandra to the crime.

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
Murder in a Small Town is on the lighter side of US styled crime drama's (although its actually a Canadian production) in a good way. 

This is an inherently likeable series, set in a picturesque, country town with a laid back, rather soulful, central character, of a police chief, who feels more like a writer or poet, (he is in fact also an artist) than hard nosed crime solving sleuth.  

Indeed, its how the central and peripheral characters are portrayed that's a big part of this series charm. There's great chemistry between the most of the characters, that breathes warmth and life, into this series. Its not just about the episodic crime stories, there's a lot of human interest surrounding the chief and those who are a part of his working and after hours, life. 

On the downside, this series can be a little syrupy at times but this only detracts fractionally, from this shows appeal. 

In summary, reminiscent of easy watching  UK crime drama's, such as "MidSomer Murders". If you don't want a lot of heavy mental lifting, preferring something light and approachable, this is definitely worth a look.
